--- justification.txt ---
Assumptions: The provided offers are the authoritative current snapshot. FP8 weights use one byte per parameter. No extra memory reserve, replicas, throughput target, or costs are specified; use the stated 8 GB deployment overhead and the stipulated aggregate tensor-parallel memory model. All GB are decimal.

Weights = 70,000,000,000 x 1 / 1,000,000,000 = 70 GB.
KV cache = 327,680 x 32,768 x 4 / 1,000,000,000 = 42.94967296 GB.
Total = 70 + 42.94967296 + 8 = 120.94967296 GB.

Choose of-117 (voltbay, us-central): 2 x H100 80GB = 160 GB, in stock, $3.58/hour, below the $4 cap. Memory headroom is 39.05032704 GB. Monthly cost = 3.58 x 730 = $2,613.40.

Exhaustive comparison: of-101 (96 GB), of-104 (80 GB), and of-113 (96 GB) lack memory. of-108 is out of stock. of-111 and of-137 are in disallowed regions. of-129 and of-133 exceed the hourly cap. The remaining feasible alternatives are of-120 (141 GB, $3.79/hour) and of-124 (192 GB, $3.92/hour), both more expensive. Thus of-117 is the cheapest feasible single offer under the stated policy. This establishes memory and rental-policy feasibility; the brief provides no throughput or latency requirement to validate.
